adoption: Separate finite-family sample study; no automatic replacement of the historical course reference. XGBoost balancing remains a separate study.

protocol.budget: Historical predeclared parameter spaces and family-specific budgets, not equal optimization capacity. Random forest has 300 fixed trees; dummy and LPM have no tuning grid.
protocol.convergence: ConvergenceWarning is fatal; logistic iteration counts must be strictly below max_iter and are recorded with each result.
protocol.historical_bridge: Phase 50 assembled category vocabularies before slicing the data. Phase 54 uses the phase-51 train-only pipeline. Changes from the historical table do not isolate the selection-metric change alone.
protocol.lpm: OLS is fitted by squared error, not log loss, and has no tuning grid. Its continuous outputs are clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6], as in phases 50/51; raw range and clipping counts are reported before scoring this diagnostic baseline.
protocol.preprocessing: Phase-51 train-only vocabulary, imputation and scaling, fitted once per family; all pipelines receive the same forty raw inputs.
protocol.probability_calibration: Raw probabilities only; no post-fit recalibration. Threshold 0.5 is descriptive, never the selection rule.
protocol.scope: Finite plain-family comparison, separate from XGBoost balancing. No automatic replacement of the historical course model or its explanations.
protocol.selection: Minimum unrounded 2023 validation log loss within each family, then across the six frozen finalists; exact ties by candidate_id. Test never chooses.
protocol.test_status: 2024 was previously inspected. No new test prediction/metric before all six finalists and the winner are frozen; later comparison is exploratory.
protocol.training: The exact committed 200,000 training records; natural class frequencies, no class weights or resampling in any family.

selection.rule: Minimum unrounded 2023 validation log loss within each family, then across the six frozen finalists; exact ties by candidate_id. Test never chooses.
